thread:
Tara N.: Heads-up: weve been flagged as confirmed for the GreenCity Dev Mixer next Fri. Booth is island D4, small footprint. Need a rapid plan for swag, session signups, and the post-event webinar funnel.
Omar G.: Nice. How many attendees expected?
Tara N.: Organizer estimating ~600 devs, mostly infra/ML ops folks. Table size is 4ft.
Nina S.: Swag inventory: 120 sticker sheets, 80 socks, 40 stress balls, 30 tee shirts in mixed sizes.
Riley M.: Socks are solid. If tees only 30, let's prioritize high-value handouts for peak traffic.
Tara N.: Agree. Proposed distribution: 1) sticker sheet + sticker codecard for everyone who signs up (scannable) 2) socks + sticker pack for first 80 signups 3) tee raffle (enter via QR) 4) on-site demo slots (3 x 20-min) signups through HubSpot.
Julian P.: Logistics: Ops can drop at loading dock 05:30. Cal (ops-bot) will confirm driver and gate pass.
Cal (ops-bot): Manifest created: Driver: Zoe, Truck ID: G20, Dock: North-2, ETA 05:30.
Omar G.: Lead capture: QR => landing page with 2 fields (email, interest). Hidden field utm_source=greencity-mixer. Trigger: immediate thank-you modal with link to webinar sign-up and optional SMS.
Nina S.: Can we pre-fill company field if OAuth via GitHub? Might reduce friction.
Riley M.: For this crowd, GitHub OAuth might be overkill. Keep it email + interest for speed.
Tara N.: Webinar tie-in: slot a 25-min webinar "Real-world LLM serving patterns" Tue after the event. We'll auto-invite booth signups. Need one short benchmark snippet in the webinar that proves cost wins.
Julian P.: Who will produce benchmark blurb? Research owes a 200-300 word blurb with 2 bullet charts. Can we get a vetted stat like "40% lower per-token cost using batching + caching"?
Riley M.: That sounds reasonable but tag it as "representative" not absolute. We'll include methodology note.
Omar G.: Follow-up flow: 1) immediate email with webinar invite + assets 2) 24h reminder 3) 72h blog post with benchmark narrative & call-to-action to request demo.
Tara N.: Messaging iteration: test two subject lines A/B: "Join our 25-min webinar on LLM serving" vs "Cut LLM inference costs 1% in practice". Track open->register conversion.
Nina S.: For swag contingency: if tees short, we can upsell a free tee coupon redeemable in our store to attendees who book demos.
Julian P.: Printables: signage for the 4ft table should include: QR big, short CTA "Scan for stickers + webinar", schedule of demo slots, and speaker name if applicable.
Riley M.: AV: none provided by venue. We'll bring battery clicker + portable charger. Also bring spare laptop dongles (HDMI, USB-C).
Cal (ops-bot): Added AV kit to manifest.
Tara N.: Photo/social plan: Quick post immediately after: "Thanks #GreenCityDev! Packed house & great chats. Missed our booth? Watch the webinar: rwd.in/greencity". Schedule for 20m after teardown.
Omar G.: Add UTM: utm_source=greencity&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=greencity2026. Also set up tracking to tag leads as "greencity-booth".
Nina S.: Action items: Riley confirm swag pack + sticker cards (today), Omar configure landing page + utm (EOD), Julian arrange manifest + ops drop (tomorrow 10am), Research to draft benchmark blurb (48h).
Tara N.: OK team, let's reconvene tomorrow at 10am for final go/no-go. :rocket:
